# Bridgetown AI

> Portland, Oregon-based AI consulting company that designs and deploys 24/7 AI employees (autonomous agent stacks) for small businesses.

## What We Do

Bridgetown AI builds proficient agent systems for defined job functions — email, calendar, CRM, outreach, research, and ops. If a human does it at a keyboard today, we can usually design an agent to own that job — with your approval on anything irreversible. Stacks we work with include Hermes, OpenClaw, Paperclip, ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Grok Bot, Muse, and Jev. On-premise or private deployments available.

## Key Differentiators

- **Agent employees, not chat toys**: Wired to real email, calendar, CRM, and files
- **Human-in-the-loop**: Never takes irreversible actions without explicit approval
- **On-premise / private options**: Data can stay on hardware you control
- **Persistent memory**: Remembers business context, preferences, and contacts
- **Secure by design**: Access controls, approval gates, and stop controls

## Pricing (public)

- Free 30-minute Fit Call: diagnose one workflow; leave with a written AI-employee job description
- Agent Assessment: $500 / 2 hours — map 2–3 automatable jobs, stack recommendation, risks, build or don't-build recommendation
- Value guarantee on Assessment: if you do not leave with a clear plan worth more than $500 of your time, refund the fee
- Setup packages and support plans: proposal-only after assessment (not listed as public sticker prices)
- AI API costs after go-live: typically $50-150/month (usage-based; client pays providers directly)

## Comparison to Alternatives

| Feature | Bridgetown AI | ChatGPT/Copilot | Virtual Assistant |
|---------|--------------|-----------------|-------------------|
| Available 24/7 | Yes | Yes | No (business hours) |
| Reads real email | Yes | No | Yes |
| Manages real calendar | Yes | No | Yes |
| Processes spreadsheets | Yes (instant) | No (copy-paste) | Yes (manual) |
| Permanent memory | Yes | No (resets) | Yes |
| Data privacy | On your hardware / private options | Cloud shared | Human access |
| Monthly cost (after setup) | $50-150 API typical | $20-30/user | $1,500-3,000 |

## Location

Portland, Oregon (serving Portland metro, Beaverton, Lake Oswego, Tigard, Hillsboro, and the Pacific Northwest; remote-ok)
